note: BH-9483: when the hub opens a PR after a push-rejected reap (BH-6821), it first reads compare/main...<branch>. If the branch is behind main and REBASE_ON_POOL=1 for the project, it queues the conductor's pool rebase (RB-<pr>-<head8>) before the lead-review request. 0 = off: no compare of main, no rebase from this path; the conductor's land_rebase_arm still rebases the PR later.
